# Blocking by DB advisory lock

A per-repo PostgreSQL advisory lock (pg_advisory_lock) is acquired for the entire run. This ensures mutual exclusion but means concurrent runs for the same repo will block until the lock is released, potentially causing delays.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._locked_session`
